card.title: Steam Deck - Power Button: Middle pad ripped off

source.title: Steam Deck - Power Button: Middle pad ripped off

claims.statement: The Steam Deck LCD power switch pads rip easily during swaps; the outer pins are ground and the middle pin goes to the ITE IT5570VG EC, but its trace dives to an inner layer with no known test point.
Compatible switches are sold as Steam Deck / Xbox 360 pair / Nintendo DS switches (same as the shoulder switch).

procedure: Use a compatible switch and low-stress soldering.
For a ripped middle pad, trace to the inner layer (see linked repair attempt).
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
